criteria.requirement: Add optional reference_datetime=None to Date and DateTime constructors. When supplied, it must be a naive datetime; reject dates, strings and aware datetimes with TypeError before parsing. Use this fixed wall-clock anchor for natural-language relative date parsing. Preserve explicit format and ISO handling, timezone parameter behavior, null handling and old defaults (Date uses ZERO_DT, DateTime captures today at midnight). Keep the anchor across pickle round trips and preserve old Date pickle states.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
